title: t27c on gft_nll.t27 -- a loss in bits, native
desc: t27c 0.5.1 and zig 0.16.0 in a Claude Code cloud container (Linux x86_64), spec at t27 72f793357: all 3 tests pass natively, none vacuous; a zero with the sign bit set from neg makes exactly one test fail, perfect; git restores the spec.
commands: sed -i 's/if (v == 0) { return 0; }/if (v == 0) { return 65536; }/' specs/ternary/gft_nll.t27 && git diff -U0 | tail -n 2
